title: Action Chunking Proximal Policy Optimization with Feedback Correction
abstract: arXiv:2609.36250v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Action chunking provides temporal abstraction in reinforcement learning by selecting short action sequences instead of individual actions, but many existing approaches face two limitations in high-dimensional robotic control. First, many rely on value functions over action chunks, which can be difficult to learn as action dimensionality and chunk length grow. Second, executing chunks open-loop removes within-chunk feedback, limiting reactivity in contact-rich tasks. We present Action Chunking PPO (ACPPO), a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic, thereby avoiding chunked Q-functions. We further propose ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk. translated_title: 带反馈修正的动作分块近端策略优化
translated_abstract: 动作分块通过选择短动作序列而非单个动作，为强化学习提供了时间抽象，但许多现有方法在高维机器人控制中面临两个局限。首先，许多方法依赖于动作块上的价值函数，随着动作维度和块长度的增长，这类价值函数可能难以学习。其次，开环执行动作块会消除块内反馈，限制了在接触密集型任务中的反应能力。我们提出了动作分块PPO（ACPPO），这是PPO的一个扩展，它使用分块的执行者，同时保留标准的状态价值评论者，从而避免了分块Q函数。我们进一步提出ACPPO-Corr，它通过一个逐步反馈修正器来增强分块规划器，可以在每个块内在线调整规划的动作。在来自IsaacGym和Bi-DexHands的25个模拟机器人任务中，涵盖运动控制、机械臂操作以及灵巧手与物体的交互，ACPPO-Corr 取得了……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了ACPPO，一种使用分块执行者但保留标准状态价值评论者的PPO扩展，从而避免了难以学习的分块Q函数，并进一步提出ACPPO-Corr，通过逐步反馈修正器在每个动作块内在线调整规划动作，在25个涵盖运动控制、机械臂操作和灵巧操作的模拟机器人任务上提升了高维控制性能。
en_tdlr: We propose ACPPO, a PPO extension that uses a chunked actor while retaining a standard state-value critic to avoid hard-to-learn chunked Q-functions, and ACPPO-Corr, which augments the chunk planner with a stepwise feedback corrector that adjusts planned actions online within each chunk, improving performance across 25 simulated robotics tasks spanning locomotion, manipulation, and dexterous hand-object interaction.
